text: Ego vehicle cruises at 110 km/h on a clear daytime highway with light traffic.
At night in heavy rain the ego car overtakes a truck on the highway at 90 km/h.
A pedestrian steps onto an urban crosswalk while the ego car brakes at 40 km/h on a clear day.
The ego vehicle turns left at a busy intersection at dusk, with an oncoming vehicle and a cyclist, at 25 km/h.
Fog on a rural road in the morning; a deer crosses and the ego car brakes at 70 km/h.
Snow on an urban street at night; the ego car turns right at 15 km/h with no other road users.
The ego car changes lane on a clear highway during the day at 100 km/h next to a truck.
In a parking lot, the ego vehicle turns right at 8 km/h while a pedestrian walks nearby, clear daytime.
Heavy rain at an intersection at night: the ego car brakes hard at 50 km/h as a vehicle runs the red light.
A cyclist rides ahead on a rural road in clear weather; the ego car overtakes at 60 km/h during the day.
The ego car cruises through fog on a highway at 80 km/h at dusk with several vehicles around.
Clear day on an urban road: the ego vehicle cruises at 50 km/h behind a bus.
Night on an urban street in light rain, the ego vehicle turns left at 30 km/h while two pedestrians cross.
Snowy rural road in daytime, the ego car cruises at 60 km/h as a truck approaches in the opposite lane.
On a clear highway at night the ego car brakes from 120 km/h because of a stopped vehicle ahead.
The ego car turns right at an intersection in clear daytime at 20 km/h, with no pedestrians nearby.
Dusk in the parking lot: the ego vehicle cruises slowly at 5 km/h as a cyclist passes.
A dog runs across a clear urban road in daytime; the ego vehicle brakes at 35 km/h.
In fog at night on a rural road, the ego car overtakes a vehicle at 80 km/h.
The ego car changes lane on an urban road in heavy snow at dusk at 45 km/h with a cyclist in the next lane.
